formula_or_definition: Scenario population: 100; edit for 1000 or 10000.
Distinct days in month with at least one accepted player turn.
Committed player intents with a final displayed narrator response divided by active days.
Retries submitted divided by accepted turns; separately track no-commit retries.
Provider-accounted narrator input tokens excluding cached tokens; split by model.
Provider-accounted cache reads per accepted turn.
Provider-accounted narrator output tokens per accepted turn.
Contracted effective input price, not public list price unless actually billed.
Contracted effective cache-read price.
Contracted effective output price.
All rules/warden/moderation calls causally attributable to a turn, net of shared allocation rule.
Embeddings/vector reads/writes/database allocation per turn; retrieval remains non-authoritative.
Successful and prevented image requests; split by Free/Mid/High and mode.
Provider invoice image cost plus associated safety/compute, divided by successful images.
Billable timeout, cancellation, and speculative discard cost divided by attempts.
Billable failed/canceled attempts divided by accepted turns.
Allocated hosting, observability, moderation operations, payment support, and support labor; document allocation.
New paid subscribers divided by eligible free cohort in defined observation window.
Gross tier revenue less processor fees, refunds, taxes/remittances and chargebacks; do not use sticker price.
Paying subscribers lost in month divided by starting paying subscribers; define voluntary/involuntary treatment.
P95 free user variable cost divided by median free user variable cost; use to stress retry/image farming.
Promotional/high-quality free turns granted to newly created user; track separately from normal free use.
Refunded paid invoices divided by paid invoices for same policy period.
active_free_players * active_days_per_player_per_month * accepted_turns_per_active_day
monthly_accepted_turns * retry_rate

(mean_input_tokens_per_turn*narrator_input_price_per_million + mean_cached_input_tokens_per_turn*narrator_cached_input_price_per_million + mean_output_tokens_per_turn*narrator_output_price_per_million)/1000000

(variable_text_cost_per_turn + adjudication_cost_per_turn + retrieval_and_storage_cost_per_turn + failed_or_canceled_attempts_per_turn*failed_or_canceled_call_cost_per_attempt) * free_abuse_multiplier

monthly_accepted_turns*variable_turn_cost + monthly_retry_attempts*failed_or_canceled_call_cost_per_attempt + active_free_players*image_requests_per_active_player_per_month*effective_image_cost_per_success
monthly_free_variable_cost + active_free_players*platform_and_support_cost_per_active_player_month
active_free_players*free_to_paid_conversion
monthly_new_paid_payers*paid_blended_net_revenue_per_payer_month*(1-refund_rate)
monthly_paid_net_revenue - monthly_free_fully_loaded_cost
monthly_free_fully_loaded_cost / (active_free_players*paid_blended_net_revenue_per_payer_month*(1-refund_rate))
